heading: Southern New England Regional Commission
lead: The region of the Southern New England Regional Commission shall include the following counties:

tree.heading: Rhode island.—
tree.text: Each county in the State of Rhode Island.

tree.heading: Connecticut.—
tree.text: The counties of Hartford, Middlesex, New Haven, New London, Tolland, and Windham in the State of Connecticut.

tree.heading: Massachusetts.—
tree.text: Each county in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.
